Mistakes in the Dataset, Needs an update on column names.

X0 Class label: 0 - Not Bankrupt, 1 - Bankrupt

X3 Current Ratio
X4 Acid Test
X5 Interest Expenses/Total Revenue

0 Bankrupt? 6819 non-null int64
